days.title: Northern Islands and Coastal Protection
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: isola di Razzoli
stops.detail: Due to the strong wind that occasionally hits the area, the geomorphological characteristics and biological qualities of the soil, endemic components such as Artemisia densiflora have developed on the island of Razzoli and Phoenician juniper thickets on almost all islands.

stops.name: isola di Mortorio
stops.detail: The park covers a land area of 5,100 hectares and a marine area of 15,046 hectares, along a front of as many as 180 km of coastline, extending from the Strait of Bonifacio and including all the islands belonging to the La Maddalena Archipelago, up to a short distance from the Gallura coast, where the smaller islands belonging to the park are located, such as the island of Mortorio, under full protection.

days.title: Garibaldi's Legacy on Caprera
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: isola di Caprera
stops.detail: On the island of Caprera there are large pine forests, which legend says were first planted by Giuseppe Garibaldi near his home.

stops.name: Memoriale Giuseppe Garibaldi
stops.detail: On the island there is also the Giuseppe Garibaldi Memorial, housed in the former fort of Arbuticci, and the tomb of the mare Marsala.
